Dear Osaka World Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the E-Commerce Specialist position at Osaka World, as advertised. My background as a Digital Marketer, focused on SEO, content, and web optimization, aligns well with the responsibilities outlined in your job description.

I possess hands-on experience in managing website content, optimizing for organic growth, and leveraging analytics to improve performance. My work on platforms like WordPress and WooCommerce has provided me with a solid understanding of online store operations. I am particularly drawn to Osaka World's international growth and commitment to innovation.

Regarding your question about digital and AI tools, I frequently leverage LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT for content, research, and audits, alongside Python scripts for workflow automation, significantly enhancing efficiency in my projects.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can contribute to your team.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Osaka World Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the E-Commerce Specialist position, having followed Osaka World's impressive journey combining sports heritage with contemporary design. As a digital marketer with a focus on SEO, content, and web optimization, I am excited by the prospect of contributing to the continued growth of your international e-commerce business.

My experience directly aligns with your need for someone who can enhance the customer experience, increase online sales, and make websites easier to manage. I have hands-on experience with CMS platforms, including WordPress and WooCommerce, where I've managed product information, published content, and optimized site structure for improved discoverability. For example, in my role at Episto, I handled on-page SEO and content for client e-commerce websites like proteinbox.com.tr, focusing on growing organic traffic.

Website optimization and SEO are core to my skill set. I regularly conduct keyword research, technical SEO audits, and implement structured data to improve organic visibility. My work on mirook.com involved implementing JSON-LD schema and iterative technical SEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score, demonstrating my proactive approach to improving website performance. I am adept at analyzing website and sales data using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs, translating insights into practical improvements for conversion.

Furthermore, my profile highlights a commercial mindset and a drive to turn websites into measurable sources of organic growth, aligning perfectly with your aim to increase online sales. I actively stay updated with new technologies, including daily use of LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT for content creation, analysis, and workflow automation, alongside developing Python scripts for process efficiency. This interest in innovation positions me to identify and implement new tools that can genuinely add value to your e-commerce processes.

I am eager to bring my blend of technical and marketing expertise to Osaka World. My ability to manage multiple projects independently, coupled with a collaborative spirit, prepares me to work effectively across your e-commerce, creative, product, and international teams. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to discussing this opportunity further.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Hands-on experience with e-commerce platforms and CMS, including managing content and product information on WordPress and WooCommerce for client websites like proteinbox.com.tr.
• Proven expertise in SEO and website optimization, including on-page SEO, keyword research, technical audits, and improving organic visibility using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs.
• Regular application of AI and LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for content creation, analysis, and workflow automation, alongside Python scripting for process efficiency.
• Strong analytical skills in monitoring website performance and customer behavior data to identify opportunities for improvement and drive measurable organic growth.
• Proactive approach to website structure and usability, with experience in implementing schema markup and conducting iterative technical SEO audits to enhance customer experience.
